description: Use this when the user asks what the public holidays are in a country or region for a given year, when a particular holiday falls, or how many holidays a year has. Covers 200+ countries with state and province detail. Do not use it for working-day arithmetic; use add_business_days for that.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, for example AU, US, GB, NZ, DE.

region.description: Optional ISO 3166-2 subdivision code such as AU-NSW or US-CA. Supply it whenever the user names a state or province, otherwise only nationwide holidays are returned.

name: list_public_holidays
title: List public holidays
